buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC (ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS) Case File No. – SP-7141, INDENT FOR Compression Spring for PCM and Stock house. 1. Other Terms & Conditions: - a) The offers shall be submitted through GeM Portal only. No other mode is acceptable. b) Bidder should necessarily submit BOQ Compliance documents.

c) Bidder should necessarily mention the quoted make of the quoted items in the Bid docu ments. d) As per GeM Provision, further extension of the offer submission due date is not allowed by the GeM Portal. Kindly submit offer on or before the due date to avoid any technical is sue. 2. Packaging: Shock proof packaging to avoid damages during transportation. The Suppli er shall be responsible for the stores being sufficiently and properly packed, so as to ens ure their being free from loss or damage on arrival at the destination. 3. Inspection Plan: Inspection at NSL Stores, Material as per TS will be the acceptance cri teria. 4. Sample Required/ Not Required: 2 nos of each line item should be send within 28 da ys after issuance of Purchase Order for approval and the same will be approved within 1 4 days. 5. Delivery Period: The material should be delivered within 42 days of sample approval. The total delivery period including sample approval shall be 84 days after the issuance o f Purchase Order. 6. Test Certificate: As per technical specification. 7. Guarantee / Warranty: Applicable as per Gem GTC (If applicable as per items / PR). 8. GST: Confirmation of percentage of GST on item wise basis. 9. Payment terms: 100% payment with applicable full taxes will be paid within 30 days o f generation of GRN after receipt and acceptance of material at NSL Stores, Nagarnar. 10. Penalty Clause: If the Seller fails to deliver any or all of the Goods within the original d elivery period (s) specified in the contract, the Buyer will reserve the right to levy/deduct /recover the penalty for the delay @ 0.5% of the contract order value of the un-delivered quantity for each week or part thereof but subject to maximum 5% (five percent) of the c ontract order value. 11. All terms and Conditions: All other terms & conditions would be applicable as per Ge m GTC and as per Gem bid documents and as per Technical Specification. 12. Earnest Money Deposit: a. Your Tender must be accompanied by EMD Rs. 15,000/- as per the bid by online payment through Bank only (EMD received though any mode other than mentioned below wi ll not be considered). Bidders intending to submit Earnest Money deposit online may foll ow following link and procedure: (i) Open the web portal: https://www.onlinesbi.com/prelogin/icollecthome.htm

(ii) Click Check Box to proceed for payment "I have read and accepted the terms and condi tions stated above" (iii) Click "Proceed "Button. (iv) Select State of Corporate/Institution * as "Chhattisgarh" and select Type corporate/Insti tution *as" PSU-PUBLIC SECTOR UNDERTAKING" and click " Go". (v) Select from PSU-PUBLIC SECTOR UNDERTAKING* name as "NMDC STEEL LIMITED" and Click "Submit". (vi) Select payment Category * as "OUTSIDERS FOR NISP NAGARNAR" (vii) Bidder may fill up their relevant details as Name, Address, GST No, Contact person Mob ile no,. Purpose (EMD/Tender paper Cost /Security Deposit, whichever is applicable as applicable), Amount (as per tender), Remarks. (viii) Bidder may also enter details such as Name, Date of Birth (For Person Banking)/Incorporation (For Corporate Banking) & Mobile Number. This is required to rep rint the e-receipt/ remittance (PAP) form, if need arises. (ix) Bidder may confirm the details and proceed for payment. (x) NMDC will not be responsible for incorrect/Wrong payment (s) made by the bidder and delay in transaction. Further, if respective amount of EMD Cost (as stipulated in tender) is not received by NMDC within due date and time of submission of tender, the correspo nding tender of non- exempted bidder(s) will be rejected. (xi) The copy of receipt(s) generated after successful payment of EMD Cost to be attached with the tender in Part I (as applicable), otherwise the corresponding tender of non-exe mpted bidder(s) will be rejected. The acceptance of the receipt is subject to verification. (xii) Non exempted bidder has to pay online for as aforesaid, separately for EMD. b. Hard Copies of Proofs of EMD, Documents towards exemption of submission of EMD OF should reach MM Department, Block-C, NMDC Iron & Steel Plant, Project office, Nagarnar, Jagdalpur-494001 well before Tender Opening. Those offers complying above condition wi ll only be considered for tender opening. c. Tender should be accompanied by Earnest money Deposit (EMD) for the amount stipulat ed above through online mode in favour of "NMDC STEEL Limited", Payable at SBI, Naga rnar. d. NMDC will not be responsible for incorrect/Wrong payment (s) made by the bidder and d elay in transaction. Further, if respective amount of EMD Cost (As stipulated in tender) is not received by NSL within due date and time of submission of tender, the corresponding tender of non- exempted bidder(s) will be rejected. e. The copy of receipt(s) generated after successful payment of EMD Cost has to be attach ed with the tender, otherwise the corresponding tender of non-exempted bidder(s) will be rejected. The acceptance of the receipt is subject to verification. f. Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) registered with appropriate authority as per latest Govt . of India notification will be exempted from payment of EMD, provided they are registere d for the items being quoted, on submission of documentary proof of such registration alo ng with request for issue of tender documents. Tenderer is requested to confirm the category under which their company/Firm is listed a s per the Micro, Small Enterprises Development Act 2006. Please furnish proof in support of the same including Registration No. if any, for extending benefits of MSME act. g. Government Departments/ Public Sector Undertakings are exempted from the payment of tender fee, if any, only. Bidders seeking exemption from submission of EMD as per Gov t. guidelines shall submit the relevant documents/ copy of the notification (Latest) well in advance to examine the case.
